note: Series Title Partner of the PIF Global Series (pifglobalseries.com footer, fetched 25 Sep 2026). PIF was named title partner of the revamped five-event series (former Aramco Team Series) in May 2025 with a $13m total prize pool (PIF press release, 2025-05-08); the 2026 series carries $15m across five events (pifglobalseries.com, 2025-11-05). ESPN (2025-05-08, Field Level Media) reported the move as a PIF investment in the LET.

source.name: PIF - PIF continues to transform women's golf as title partner of revamped global series
